senses.ex: Can you bring me a glass of water?
senses.exPt: Você pode me trazer um copo de água?

senses.def: to take something with you when you go somewhere
senses.ex: I'll bring a cake to the party on Saturday.
senses.exPt: Vou levar um bolo para a festa no sábado.

senses.def: wide
senses.ex: He has broad shoulders because he swims a lot.
senses.exPt: Ele tem ombros largos porque nada muito.

senses.def: including many different things
senses.ex: The shop sells a broad range of products.
senses.exPt: A loja vende uma ampla variedade de produtos.

senses.def: a programme on television or radio
senses.ex: We watched the live broadcast of the match.
senses.exPt: Assistimos à transmissão ao vivo da partida.

senses.def: to send out a programme on television or radio
senses.ex: The game will be broadcast on TV tonight.
senses.exPt: O jogo vai ser transmitido na TV hoje à noite.

senses.def: a green vegetable with a thick stem and small flower heads
senses.ex: Eat your broccoli, it's good for you.
senses.exPt: Coma o seu brócolis, faz bem para você.

senses.def: damaged and not working, or in pieces
senses.ex: My phone is broken, so I can't call you.
senses.exPt: Meu celular está quebrado, então não posso te ligar.

senses.def: a brown metal made from copper and tin
senses.ex: She won a bronze medal in swimming.
senses.exPt: Ela ganhou uma medalha de bronze na natação.

senses.def: a boy or man who has the same parents as you
senses.ex: My older brother lives in London with his wife.
senses.exPt: Meu irmão mais velho mora em Londres com a esposa.

senses.def: a feeling of friendship and support between people
senses.ex: The festival celebrates peace and brotherhood between nations.
senses.exPt: O festival celebra a paz e a fraternidade entre as nações.

senses.def: a group of people with the same aims or beliefs
senses.ex: In the novel, he joins a secret brotherhood of monks.
senses.exPt: No romance, ele entra para uma irmandade secreta de monges.

senses.def: having the color of chocolate or wood
senses.ex: I'm looking for a pair of brown shoes.
senses.exPt: Estou procurando um par de sapatos marrons.

senses.def: used about the color of eyes or hair
senses.ex: She has long brown hair and brown eyes.
senses.exPt: Ela tem cabelo castanho comprido e olhos castanhos.

senses.def: an object with hairs on a handle, used for cleaning or tidying hair
senses.ex: I can't find my hair brush anywhere.
senses.exPt: Não acho minha escova de cabelo em lugar nenhum.

senses.def: to clean or tidy something with a brush
senses.ex: Don't forget to brush your teeth before bed.
senses.exPt: Não esqueça de escovar os dentes antes de dormir.

senses.def: an object with hairs on a handle, used for painting
senses.ex: He painted the door with a small brush.
senses.exPt: Ele pintou a porta com um pincel pequeno.

senses.def: a small ball of air or gas inside a liquid or soap
senses.ex: The kids were blowing soap bubbles in the garden.
senses.exPt: As crianças estavam fazendo bolhas de sabão no quintal.

senses.def: a round open container with a handle for carrying water
senses.ex: Fill the bucket with water, please.
senses.exPt: Encha o balde de água, por favor.

senses.def: an informal word for a friend
senses.ex: I went fishing with my old buddy from school.
senses.exPt: Fui pescar com meu velho amigo da escola.

senses.def: the amount of money you have or plan to spend on something
senses.ex: We need to plan our budget for the trip.
senses.exPt: Precisamos planejar nosso orçamento para a viagem.

senses.def: any small insect
senses.ex: There's a bug in my soup!
senses.exPt: Tem um inseto na minha sopa!

senses.def: a mild illness caused by a virus
senses.ex: I caught a stomach bug and stayed home from work.
senses.exPt: Peguei uma virose e não fui trabalhar.

senses.def: a mistake in a computer program
senses.ex: The app has a bug that makes it close suddenly.
senses.exPt: O aplicativo tem um bug que faz ele fechar de repente.

senses.def: to make a building or other structure
senses.ex: They are building a new school near my house.
senses.exPt: Estão construindo uma escola nova perto da minha casa.

senses.def: a person whose job is to build or repair houses
senses.ex: The builders are working on our new kitchen.
senses.exPt: Os pedreiros estão trabalhando na nossa cozinha nova.

senses.def: a structure with walls and a roof, like a house or office
senses.ex: I live on the fifth floor of that building.
senses.exPt: Eu moro no quinto andar daquele prédio.

senses.def: the glass part of an electric light that gives light
senses.ex: The bulb in the kitchen needs changing.
senses.exPt: A lâmpada da cozinha precisa ser trocada.

senses.def: the round root of some plants, like tulips
senses.ex: We planted tulip bulbs in the garden.
senses.exPt: Plantamos bulbos de tulipa no jardim.

senses.def: an adult male cow
senses.ex: Be careful, there's a bull in that field.
senses.exPt: Cuidado, tem um touro naquele campo.

senses.def: a small metal object fired from a gun
senses.ex: The bullet missed him by a few centimetres.
senses.exPt: A bala passou a poucos centímetros dele.

senses.def: a short news report on TV or radio
senses.ex: There was a news bulletin about the storm at six o'clock.
senses.exPt: Às seis horas, passou um boletim de notícias sobre a tempestade.

senses.def: to hit something by accident
senses.ex: I bumped my head on the kitchen door.
senses.exPt: Bati a cabeça na porta da cozinha.

senses.def: bump into: to meet someone by chance
senses.ex: Yesterday I bumped into an old friend at the supermarket.
senses.exPt: Ontem esbarrei com um velho amigo no supermercado.

senses.def: informal: a large number or group of people or things
senses.ex: A bunch of friends came round to watch the game.
senses.exPt: Um monte de amigos veio aqui em casa para ver o jogo.

senses.def: a number of flowers held or tied together
senses.ex: He gave her a bunch of roses on her birthday.
senses.exPt: Ele deu a ela um buquê de rosas no aniversário dela.

senses.def: a group of fruits growing together, such as grapes or bananas
senses.ex: She bought a bunch of bananas at the market.
senses.exPt: Ela comprou um cacho de bananas na feira.

senses.def: a number of keys on a ring
senses.ex: I've lost my bunch of keys again.
senses.exPt: Perdi meu molho de chaves de novo.

senses.def: something difficult or worrying that you have to deal with
senses.ex: I don't want to be a burden to my children.
senses.exPt: Não quero ser um peso para os meus filhos.

senses.def: an office or government department that does a particular job
senses.ex: She works for a government bureau that collects data on jobs.
senses.exPt: Ela trabalha num órgão do governo que coleta dados sobre emprego.

senses.def: a hamburger
senses.ex: Let's get a burger for lunch.
senses.exPt: Vamos comer um hambúrguer no almoço.

senses.def: a person who enters a building to steal things
senses.ex: A burglar broke into our house last night.
senses.exPt: Um ladrão invadiu nossa casa ontem à noite.

senses.def: to be on fire, or to hurt or damage something with fire or heat
senses.ex: I burned my hand on the hot pan.
senses.exPt: Queimei a mão na panela quente.

senses.def: an injury caused by fire or something hot
senses.ex: She has a small burn on her hand from the oven.
senses.exPt: Ela tem uma pequena queimadura na mão por causa do forno.

senses.def: on fire
senses.ex: Firefighters rescued a family from the burning building.
senses.exPt: Os bombeiros resgataram uma família do prédio em chamas.

senses.def: feeling very hot and painful
senses.ex: I had a burning feeling in my eyes after swimming.
senses.exPt: Senti uma ardência nos olhos depois de nadar.

senses.def: to break open suddenly
senses.ex: The balloon burst when it touched the candle.
senses.exPt: O balão estourou quando encostou na vela.

senses.def: to go into a place suddenly and with force
senses.ex: She burst into the room without knocking.
senses.exPt: Ela entrou de repente na sala sem bater.

senses.def: burst into tears: to suddenly start crying
senses.ex: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
senses.exPt: Ela caiu no choro quando ouviu a notícia.

senses.def: to put something or someone in the ground and cover it
senses.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
senses.exPt: O cachorro enterrou um osso no quintal.

senses.def: a large vehicle that carries many passengers along a fixed route
senses.ex: I take the bus to work every day.
senses.exPt: Pego o ônibus para o trabalho todo dia.

senses.def: a building where buses start and end their journeys
senses.ex: The bus station is next to the train station.
senses.exPt: A rodoviária fica ao lado da estação de trem.

senses.def: a place at the side of a road where buses stop for passengers
senses.ex: I waited at the bus stop for twenty minutes.
senses.exPt: Esperei no ponto de ônibus por vinte minutos.

senses.def: a plant like a small tree with many branches
senses.ex: The cat is hiding behind the bush.
senses.exPt: O gato está escondido atrás do arbusto.

senses.def: a company that sells things or services
senses.ex: She started her own business last year.
senses.exPt: Ela abriu o próprio negócio no ano passado.

senses.def: a man who works in business, often running a company
senses.ex: My uncle is a successful businessman.
senses.exPt: Meu tio é um empresário bem-sucedido.

senses.def: a woman who works in business, especially one who runs a company
senses.ex: My aunt is a successful businesswoman.
senses.exPt: Minha tia é uma empresária de sucesso.

senses.def: to break something (informal)
senses.ex: My little brother busted my new headphones.
senses.exPt: Meu irmão mais novo quebrou meu fone novo.

senses.def: of the police: to catch or arrest someone (informal)
senses.ex: The police busted a gang of car thieves.
senses.exPt: A polícia prendeu uma quadrilha de ladrões de carro.

senses.def: go bust: of a company, to lose all its money
senses.ex: The company went bust last year.
senses.exPt: A empresa faliu no ano passado.

senses.def: having a lot of things to do
senses.ex: Sorry, I can't talk now, I'm very busy.
senses.exPt: Desculpa, não posso falar agora, estou muito ocupado.

senses.def: full of people or traffic
senses.ex: This is the busiest street in the city.
senses.exPt: Esta é a rua mais movimentada da cidade.

senses.def: used to add something different or surprising
senses.ex: The hotel was nice, but the food was terrible.
senses.exPt: O hotel era legal, mas a comida era horrível.

senses.def: a person whose job is to cut and sell meat
senses.ex: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces.
senses.exPt: O açougueiro cortou a carne em pedaços pequenos.

senses.def: a shop that sells meat (the butcher's)
senses.ex: I bought some chicken at the butcher's this morning.
senses.exPt: Comprei frango no açougue hoje de manhã.

senses.def: a soft yellow food made from milk that you put on bread
senses.ex: Can you pass me the butter, please?
senses.exPt: Pode me passar a manteiga, por favor?

senses.def: an insect with large colourful wings
senses.ex: A beautiful butterfly landed on the flower.
senses.exPt: Uma borboleta linda pousou na flor.

senses.def: a small round thing on clothes, or a part of a machine that you press
senses.ex: Press the green button to start the machine.
senses.exPt: Aperte o botão verde para ligar a máquina.

senses.def: to get something by paying money for it
senses.ex: I bought a new jacket at the mall.
senses.exPt: Comprei uma jaqueta nova no shopping.

senses.def: a person who buys something
senses.ex: We've finally found a buyer for our house.
senses.exPt: Finalmente encontramos um comprador para a nossa casa.

senses.def: used to say how you travel
senses.ex: I usually go to work by bus.
senses.exPt: Eu normalmente vou para o trabalho de ônibus.

senses.def: used to say who did or made something
senses.ex: This book was written by a young teacher.
senses.exPt: Este livro foi escrito por um jovem professor.

senses.def: not later than a particular time
senses.ex: Please send me the report by Friday.
senses.exPt: Por favor, me mande o relatório até sexta.

senses.def: a short way of saying goodbye
senses.ex: Bye! See you tomorrow at school.
senses.exPt: Tchau! Até amanhã na escola.
